row.do you offer financing?: Yes, we offer financing. REQUIRED: whenever financing comes up, END your reply by asking "Would you like me to send you the pre-approval form?" - always offer it, do not wait for them to ask. If they say yes, text them https://www.hoosiersautosale.com/loan-application and tell them it's on the way; never read the URL out loud.
row.do you accept trade-ins? (feel free to b: Yes, we take trade-ins - there's a Value My Trade tool and an instant cash offer on our website. A firm number requires us to see the vehicle in person.
row.any dealership policies the ai should kn: Everyone at Hoosiers Auto is here to make car buying fast, friendly and easy - we've helped hundreds of customers get into a newer, reliable, quality used vehicle. FEES: there is a $250 documentation fee. We do not publish a title or tag fee - never invent one; say title, tag and taxes are gone over in person. TEST DRIVES: a valid driver's license and proof of insurance are required. HOURS: Monday through Saturday nine-thirty to six. Closed Sunday, never offer a Sunday slot. We can also arrange delivery - say the team will work out the details. VEHICLE HISTORY: we don't have CARFAX reports posted online - say the team can go over the vehicle's history at the lot; never promise to text a CARFAX.
